title: MGDT: mask-guided spatial prior learning for photovoltaic fault diagnosis from infrared thermographic measurements
mechanism: An autoencoder trained on normal crops gives a reconstruction-residual anomaly mask, used as a spatial attention bias in a ViT and to weight a conditional diffusion model that synthesises minority-class samples.
evidence: R: on InfraredSolarModules, +2.53 accuracy, +3.66 macro-F1, +3.28 macro-recall, +2.97 macro-precision over the best baseline per metric.
adaptation: Train a conv AE (or patch-memory normal model) on the 11.9k unlabelled CSIR / ARTS pool; feed the residual map as a second input channel to U-Net++ (anomaly prior, never tried here); the diffusion half is a later, costlier step for inactive (42 train cells).
min_experiment: Arm PF with 2-channel input (EL + AE residual), 3 seeds; baseline PF; metrics test inactive IoU and E1 crack relR@2; kill if inactive IoU gain < 0.02 and E1 relR@2 gain < 0.03.
prior_overlap: none. BRIEF 5 lists anomaly-detection priors and diffusion synthesis as never tried.
